text:
maya: Heads up — starting ~05:12UTC we've seen a sharp KV prefix cache hit-rate collapse on europe-west shards. p95 latency up ~3x. Anyone watching?

ravi: saw the alert. digging into metrics now. kv.prefix_hit_rate dropped from ~0.92 -> 0.12 on gpunode-07, evictions/sec jumped to ~4.5k.

olga: timeline? any config rollouts around 05:10-05:15?

infra-bot: deploy:kernel-select-rollout v2 -> 30% of runtime pool started at 2026-03-18T05:11:42Z (user: ci/canary-pipeline)

maya: that matches. we flipped the new kernel-selection heuristic yesterday night (feature flag: runtime.kernel_v2=true). didn't expect it to touch prefix hashing but can be correlated.

ravi: quick profiling snapshot: hot keys show extremely uneven prefix distribution after rollout — a handful of prefixes now cause long probe chains in the in-memory hash map. suspect new probe sequence changed collision behavior. stack counters: 
```
kv_map_probes_avg: 7.9 -> 42.3
kv_map_chain_length_p95: 1 -> 18
```

sam: logs show repeated prefix_lookup failures with 'rehash required' and then eviction thrash:
```
2026-03-18T05:12:13Z [runtime] prefix_lookup key=tenant:acme:ctx:5 reason=hash_mismatch
2026-03-18T05:12:13Z [runtime] evict candidate key=tenant:acme:ctx:2 state=recently_used
```

jordan: is this a noisy-tenant effect (single customer with many different prefixes) or a general distribution shift?

ravi: it's noisy-tenant + algorithmic. tenant "acme" accounts for ~48% of eviction churn on the affected shard. The new probing changed collision resolution order so many of their prefixes no longer co-locate; that increased eviction pressure and collapsed effective cache locality.

olga: mitigation idea: 1) rollback kernel_v2 rollout to stop new nodes applying the heuristic, 2) temporarily raise per-tenant KV reservation for top noisy tenants, 3) bump TTL to keep items in cache while we stabilize.

maya: I'm pushing rollback now. sam, can you open a fast-mode knob to raise tenant-reserve for tenants matching "acme*" to 5% of shard?

sam: doing the reserve bump (ui -> tenants -> acme -> reserve=5%). patch applied at 05:18UTC.

infra-bot: rollback:kernel-select-rollout completed (v2 -> removed) at 2026-03-18T05:20:01Z (initiator: maya)

ravi: after rollback + reserve: kv.prefix_hit_rate climbed from 0.12 -> 0.78 on gpunode-07 in ~90s, evictions/sec dropped to ~300. p95 latency back to baseline.

maya: great. we'll need a root-cause triage: suspect change in hash seed/probing order in kernel_v2. assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for kernel selection correctness and perf tests.

olga: logging action items:
- capture deterministic reproducer of prefix collisions (ravi)
- add unit/perf test for collision distributions across real tenant key shapes (eng-ml)
- add a guard in rollout pipeline: measure kv.prefix_hit_rate delta > 10% -> auto-hold (eng-infra)
- postmortem in incidents (owner: maya)

jordan: +1 on auto-hold — we should gate kernel heuristics changes with a small cache-metric smoke test in canaries.

maya: I'll create the incident doc and assign follow-ups. thanks for quick responses. :thumbsup:
